blocks.text: 102 מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 102
uncertainties: The pointing of רִאשׁוֹן and רֹאשׁ in the running head is faint. It may be partly unpointed.

blocks.text: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.

מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:
uncertainties: There may be a meteg in בְּחֶסֶד. I can't confirm it.
I can't tell whether the lamed in לָּךְ has a dagesh.
This is in the left margin, level with the last line of מכלכל. It is unpointed.
This is above the piyyut, at the left. It appears to mark a reversed alphabetic acrostic (תשר״ק). I have not expanded the abbreviation.

blocks.text: ק׳ תֵּפֶן בְּמָכוֹן לְכֵס שֶׁבֶת. שְׁעוֹן וּמוּסָר כְּעָלוֹ בְּמַחֲשֶׁבֶת. רָם תְּהִי אָזְנְךָ קַשֶּׁבֶת. קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שְׁעוֹת מְנוּשֶּׁבֶת: צָרַת אֹמֶר לֹא יָדוֹן. פַּעֲמַיִם לֹא תָקוּם לַאֲבַדּוֹן. עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְבָּעָה נִדּוֹן. סְמוֹךְ בְּחַסְדְּךָ וּבַאֲמִתְּךָ אָדוֹן: נוֹעָדִים כְּיוֹם קְרָב וְנִלְחָמִים. מוּל אֶבֶן נֶגֶף מִתְלַחֲמִים. לִיבּוּב תְּרוּעָתָם שְׁעֵה מִמְּרוֹמִים. כִּסֵּא דִין לְהָמִיר בְּשֶׁל רַחֲמִים: יְחִיד אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵקֶד נִשְׁפָּט. טְלָאָיו יְחֻנָּנוּ מִלְּהִשָּׁפֵט. חָלִילָה לְּךָ אֱלֹהֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּט. זְכוֹר לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט: וְאִם כְּאָדָם עָבְרוּ בְרִית. הָאֵל כְּאֵל הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית.
uncertainties: ק׳ is a small superscript speaker marker (probably the congregation). I kept it inline.
מְנוּשֶּׁבֶת: the vowel under the shin (segol or qamats) and the dagesh are uncertain.
נִדּוֹן: the vowel under the nun and the dagesh in the dalet are uncertain.
נוֹעָדִים: the vowel under the ayin could be qamats or hataf-patah.
I can't confirm a dagesh in בְרִית after עָבְרוּ, in מִלְּהִשָּׁפֵט, or in לְּךָ.
Some letters are stretched to justify lines (צָרַת, בְּאַרְבָּעָה, שְׁעֵה, עוֹלָם). This is typographic only.
Line-final periods are printed as diamond-shaped dots.

blocks.text: ח׳ דִּבְּרוֹת אֵלֶּה דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית. גַּלֵּה (כ״א גֹּל) בְּזִכְרוֹן שְׁלוֹשׁ בְּרִית:
uncertainties: ח׳ is a small speaker marker (probably the cantor). It falls in the middle of a line.
(כ״א גֹּל) is printed smaller and gives an alternative reading for גַּלֵּה. I have not expanded the abbreviation כ״א.
I can't confirm the dagesh in the bet of דִּבְּרוֹת.

blocks.text: ק׳ עוֹלָם בְּבַקְּרְךָ בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה. בְּהַכְרָעַת צֶדֶק תַּכְרִיעַ (כ״א תְּעַטֵּר) שָׁנָה.
uncertainties: The pointing of בְּבַקְּרְךָ is uncertain. It could be בְּבַקֶּרְךָ, or have no dagesh.
(כ״א תְּעַטֵּר) is small. It starts the next line, before שָׁנָה, and is an alternative to תַּכְרִיעַ.

blocks.text: ח׳ אֲסוּמָה טְלוּלָה גְּשׁוּמָה אִם שְׁחוּנָה. אֲטוּמִים לְהַחֲיוֹת בְּטַלְלֵי שֵׁנָה (כ״א שָׁנָה):
uncertainties: (כ״א שָׁנָה) is small and gives an alternative reading for שֵׁנָה. The colon comes after the parenthesis.

blocks.text: Thou art forever mighty, O Lord the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save.

Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling, healing the sick, and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.

When Thou in heaven turnest to the throne with the intent to warn and to chastise, then may Thine ear, Exalted One, listen to the sound of the Shofar that rises up from the earth. The punishment of that sentence no longer to dispute (with the generations of man before the flood) will not return to cause havoc; as for the world which four days each year is judged, support it in Thy grace and in Thy truth, O Lord. For battle are we gathered, against the stone of offence (evil inclination) do we battle; listen from the heights to the plaintive sound of the Teruah, exchange the throne of judgment for the throne of compassion. May the descendants of that only son who was summoned for sacrifice, be treated leniently in the course of justice; remember that plea: Far be it from Thee, O God of justice, not to administer justice. Though they as human beings have transgressed the Covenant, do Thou, as God, regard the Covenant; remove the threat of punishment of the Covenant since Thou rememberest the Covenant with the three forefathers.
uncertainties: 'judg-ment' and 'Cove-nant' (twice) and 'remem-berest' are hyphenated across lines in print. I have joined them.

blocks.text: When Thou dost examine the world on the day of the New Year, determine the year favourably, rich in fruit, dew and rain in the heat, so as to awaken to life from the grave through the dew of the year.

notes: I read both full page images and all four enlarged bands for s224. For s225 I read only the full page image. It was clearly legible, so I did not open the s225 bands.
Neither page has footnotes, biblical citations, sound sequences, Hebrew-script German, or bottom text. The lower part of both pages is blank.

Neither page has cantillation. Bracketed or parenthetical additions appear only as the three small (כ״א …) alternative readings. I have not stated what condition they apply to. There are no Shabbat additions.
The small markers ק׳ and ח׳ inside the piyyutim are speaker markers. I left them inline at their printed positions and did not expand them.
The English does not translate the rubrics סוגרים הארון and ע״ס תשר״ק.
Pointing is hard to read at this resolution for several words. These are listed in the uncertainties for each block.
